intro: The Missing Scholar follows the search for Fillion Flamebreeze, a researcher who vanished while returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones. An investigation of the trail leads into a nearby northern cave where Fillion was dragged by a predatory winged beast.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Th... Thank you, stranger. I was returning from an assignment at the Overlook Standing Stones when I was suddenly ambushed and attacked by Windshapers. They forced me over to the mouth of the cave and left me there, barely conscious and bleeding. The last thing I remember before blacking out is a massive winged beast emerging from the cave and scooping me up.
I think it's safe to say that if you hadn't come along, I'd have been dinner for that beast and its younglings.
